senses.gloss: (cmp. דלי, a. b. h. נָשָׂא quoted in preced. art.) to carry away, to lift, bear, sustain.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 66b">Sabb. 66ᵇ</cite> a big ant <he>דדָרֵי מידי</he> which is carrying something.
<cite ref="Megillah 28a:7">Meg. 28ᵃ</cite> <he>ד׳ מרא וכ׳</he> was carrying a rake over his shoulder.
<cite ref="Megillah 28a:7">Ib.</cite> <he>אתא … וקא ד׳ מיניה</he> ed. (Ms. M. a. Ar. <he>שקיל</he>) R. Ḥ. came and took it from him (to carry it himself).
<cite ref="Megillah 28a:7">Ib.</cite> <he>אי רגילת דדָרִית במתך דְּרִי</he> if thou, in thy own place, art accustomed to carry (such things), carry it.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 44a:15">Ab. Zar. 44ᵃ</cite> it was a magnetic stone <he>דהות דַּרְיָא ליה</he> Rashi (ed. <cite ref="D01029"><he>דרא</he></cite>, Yalk. Ms.
<cite ref="II Samuel 12:30">II Sam. to XII, 30</cite> <cite ref="D00830"><he>דליא</he></cite>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 9) which sustained it (held the crown suspended).—

<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 32a:2">Ab. Zar. 32ᵃ</cite> <he>ודָרוּ בהדייהו</he> and they carry (the fragments of soaked clay vessels) with them (Ms. M. <he>ודרו ליה במיא</he>, v. <cite ref="V00979"><he>תְּרִי</he></cite>); a. fr.—

<cite ref="Shabbat 77a:1">Sabb. 77ᵃ</cite> <he>כל חמרא דלא דרי וכ׳</he> a wine which bears not an admixture of three (measures of water) to one, is no wine; <cite ref="Bava Batra 96b:4">B. Bath. 96ᵇ</cite> <cite ref="D01080"><he>דָּארֵי</he></cite>; <cite ref="Eruvin 29b:5">Erub. 29ᵇ</cite>.  v. <cite ref="D00351"><he>דּוּרָא</he> IV</cite>.

senses.gloss: to be carried off; to get up involuntarily to save something.
units: <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 59b">Ab. Zar. 59ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 60b">60ᵇ</cite>. Y. Sabb. III, 5ᵈ top <he>ואִידְּרוּן חברייא וכ׳</he> the colleagues jumped up trying to bring him back.
